stem: Meena's teacher asks why the sweet potato in her kitchen garden contains starch, even though the food is made in the leaves of the plant. Which explanation is correct?

options.text: Food made in the leaves reaches the sweet potato through the phloem.
Food made in the leaves reaches the sweet potato through the xylem.
The sweet potato makes its own food from minerals absorbed from the soil.
Water carrying minerals from the roots turns into starch in the sweet potato.

teacher.key_rationale: Food prepared in leaves by photosynthesis is transported to storage and growing parts through phloem, so A is correct. B is the sibling-term trap (xylem carries water and minerals), C reverses where the starch comes from, and D wrongly credits mineral transport with starch formation.
